verdict_bind.name: syntax: only parenthesised groups are parsed; a verdict written outside parentheses makes no claim
verdict_bind.command: python3 -c "import re; print(re.findall(r'\(([^()]{2,220})\)', open('line5907').read()))"  # line 5907 of SCORECARD.md at 6767a879

... 'A12 case-independence closure' :: sole true :: unknown_field
... PROVINCE.md line 585 :: mismatch 1 :: unknown_field
